rows.grounds: architectural member; subject or compared element
architectural member; subject or compared element

items.question: What proportional equality must the support and head maintain with the bharaṇī and kapotālī?
premises: The bharaṇa is a specified architectural support member.
The śīrṣa is a specified architectural head member.
The bharaṇī and kapotālī serve as measures of comparison.
The prescribed relation is equality of measure.
items.inference: The support and the head should be made equal in measure to the bharaṇī and the kapotālī.
uncertainties: The exact dimensional correspondence between bharaṇa/śīrṣa and bharaṇī/kapotālī is not specified in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: The support and the head should be equal to the bharaṇī and the kapotālī.
